plain_english: When will my mind, eager to taste new-rasa-moist union, rush past all else to Your touch?
sanskrit_cite: kadā navarasārdrārdrasambhogāsvādanotsukam pravarteta vihāyānyan mama tvatsparśane manaḥ

plain_english: You-loving, worship-wealthy — when shall I, the eager one, see You face to face?
sanskrit_cite: tvadekaraktas tvatpādapūjāmātramahādhanaḥ kadā sākṣātkariṣyāmi bhavantam ayam utsukaḥ

plain_english: When, by thick love made needless-minded, shall I burst all great bolts with a crash and reach You?
sanskrit_cite: gāḍhānurāgavaśato nirapekṣībhūtamānaso 'smi kadā paṭapaṭiti vighaṭitākhilamahārgalas tvām upaiṣyāmi

plain_english: When, Lord, shall I subdue all gods — heart-seated in my own consciousness-essence — by devotion's power?
sanskrit_cite: svasaṃvitsārahṛdayādhiṣṭhānāḥ sarvadevatāḥ kadā nātha vaśīkuryāṃ bhavadbhaktiprabhāvataḥ

plain_english: When will my vast devotion-bliss-rasa festival be — where even distinction gets a name from beholding-joy?
sanskrit_cite: kadā me syād vibho bhūri bhaktyānandarasotsavaḥ yadālokasukhānandī pṛthaṅ nāmāpi lapsyate

plain_english: Having suddenly recognized the fearless, generous, full, causeless, self-hidden Lord — when shall I shame Your people?
sanskrit_cite: īśvaram abhayam udāraṃ pūrṇam akāraṇam apahnutātmānaṃ sahasābhijñāya kadā svāmijanaṃ lajjayiṣyāmi

plain_english: When, Lord, that beloved-ness of Yours by which it would not be fitting for You to flee from me anywhere?
sanskrit_cite: kadā kām api tāṃ nātha tava vallabhatām iyām yayā māṃ prati na kvāpi yuktaṃ te syāt palāyitum

plain_english: When shall I be bathed by the approving sight of all beings whose selves are Your worship?
sanskrit_cite: tattvato 'śeṣajantūnāṃ bhavatpūjāmayātmanām dṛṣṭyānumoditarasāplāvitaḥ syāṃ kadā vibho

plain_english: Devotion, the highest ground of knowledge, the highest state of yoga — when will my begging for it be full?
sanskrit_cite: jñānasya paramā bhūmir yogasya paramā daśā tvadbhaktir yā vibho karhi pūrṇa me syāt tadarthitā

plain_english: Seizing suddenly, holding hard, joy-overwhelmed — when shall I proclaim Your foot-treasure to all?
sanskrit_cite: sahasaivasādya kadā gāḍham avaṣṭabhya harṣavivaśo 'ham tvaccaraṇavaranidhānaṃ sarvasya prakaṭayiṣyāmi

plain_english: All-around pure-You-light-spread — when shall I so shine that no Māyā-shadow-cave is in me?
sanskrit_cite: paritaḥ prasaracchuddhatvadālokamayaḥ kadā syāṃ yatheśa na kiñcin me māyācchāyābilaṃ bhavet

plain_english: Having made all circles my own, need-free — when shall I be, Lord, leader of Your devotee-host?
sanskrit_cite: ātmasātkṛtaniḥśeṣamaṇḍalo nirvyapekṣakaḥ kadā bhaveyaṃ bhagavaṃs tvadbhaktagaṇanāyakaḥ

plain_english: Lord, You are the unprecedented ground of world-prides — when shall I be greatly proud, filled with Your devotion-rasa?
sanskrit_cite: nātha lokābhimānānām apūrvaṃ tvaṃ nibandhanam mahābhimānaḥ karhi syāṃ tvadbhaktirasapūritaḥ

plain_english: Well-set in never-object-empty glory-embrace — when shall I lie like at cool lotus-feet?
sanskrit_cite: aśeṣaviṣayāśūnyaśrīsamāśleṣasusthitaḥ śayīyam iva śītāṅghrikuśeśayayuge kadā

plain_english: Of worship-wealth grown rich on devotion-liquor — when shall I reach the far shore, when be apt?
sanskrit_cite: bhaktyāsavasamṛddhāyās tvatpūjābhogasampadaḥ kadā pāraṃ gamiṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi kadā kṛtī

plain_english: Tears first, stumbling, wandering, choked crying — laughing-lit face: when shall I get Your touch-rasa?
sanskrit_cite: ānandabāṣpapūraskhalitaparibhrāntagadgadākrandaḥ hāsollāsitavadanas tvatsparśarasaṃ kadāpsyāmi

plain_english: Shaking off this beast-people-like conduct — when shall I, O Śambhu, taste the self-form fit for Your devotion?
sanskrit_cite: paśujanasamānavṛttām avadhūya daśām imāṃ kadā śambho āsvādayeya tāvakabhaktocitam ātmano rūpam

plain_english: Siddhis gained, all heat-fear melted — when shall I play, devoted to drinking Your devotion-rasa-medicine?
sanskrit_cite: labdhāṇimādisiddhir vigalitasakalopatāpasantrāsaḥ tvadbhaktirasāyanapānakriḍhāniṣṭaḥ kadāsīya

plain_english: Lord, when shall that cry of mine rise in speech — at which Your form flashes before me at once?
sanskrit_cite: nātha kadā sa tathāvidha ākrando me samuccared vāci yat samanantaram eva sphurati puras tāvakī mūrtiḥ

plain_english: Mind set on hugging Your tight-tight lotus-feet — when shall I see You, thing or non-thing, without effort?
sanskrit_cite: gāḍhagāḍhabhavadaṅghrisarojāliṅganavyasanatatparacetāḥ vastv avastv idam ayatnata eva tvāṃ kadā samavalokayitāsmi
